## Release — backlog-campaign v0.34.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.34.0

Covers the 42 PRs merged since v0.33.0, including the 0.33.1–0.33.4 patch bumps that shipped untagged.

#### New

- **The launch gate names its target.** It shows the campaign it resolved and asks when that differs from the target you stated ([#1469](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1469)).
- **`queue-migrate` upgrades old queues.** It rewrites legacy queue statuses and phases to the current ones ([#1485](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1485)).
- **V-CONFIG-03 checks the launch summary column** ([#1487](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1487)).

#### Safer merges and CI reading

- The merge gate fails closed on a truncated checks snapshot, pages through every check run, and requires the total check count on a merged snapshot ([#1441](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1441), [#1482](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1482)).
- Campaign status ignores superseded cancelled runs when judging a PR's CI ([#1443](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1443)).
- Playbooks stop before `gh` when a forge-scope lookup fails ([#1492](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1492)).

#### Usage and pacing

- A stale `--usage` file now fails closed instead of falling back to the shared cache ([#1447](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1447)).
- A rate-limit cache written by another account is refused ([#1471](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1471)).
- `decide` counts finished issues from a legacy sleep baseline with no weekly reading ([#1446](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1446)).

#### Write guard (hooks)

- Quoted message text in `gh` and `git commit` bodies is read as text, not as a redirect ([#1483](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1483)).
- A redirect target ends at an unquoted `;`, `&` or `|`, as in bash ([#1451](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1451)).
- The shell-exec scan stays linear on long scripts without spaces ([#1444](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1444)).

#### Carrying docs into consumer repos

- Staged entries are all planned before any is written, so a refused row writes nothing ([#1486](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1486)).
- Row fragments whose shape does not match the index are refused, and escaped pipes stay intact ([#1477](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1477), [#1445](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1445), [#1448](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1448)).
- Active Constraints is matched as a real heading and added when `ARCHITECTURE.md` lacks it ([#1479](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1479), [#1474](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1474)).
- A consumer's own root INDEX is never regenerated over ([#1421](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1421), [#1460](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1460)).
- ADR status is read from the index column by its header name ([#1468](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1468)).

#### Workers, ledger and stacked plans

- Worker returns are recovered from Claude desktop handback transcripts and from the last assistant turn ([#1457](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1457), [#1464](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1464)).
- The ledger has one optional severity, INFO, and migrates mercure HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severities ([#1453](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1453), [#1461](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1461)).
- Stacked plans match issues on plan Touch-Paths, honour `default_touch_paths` and join `package_root` for sub-packages ([#1456](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1456), [#1463](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1463), [#1470](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1470)).
- Two sessions on one campaign directory now see each other ([#1472](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1472)).
- A staging manifest that is not an object is refused with a clear error ([#1437](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1437)).

#### Installs

- The plugin root resolves from `BLACKHOLE_PLUGIN_ROOT`, then `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`, and fails loudly otherwise ([#1489](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1489)).
- Plugin drift resolves the hooks helper in an installed plugin and describes the campaign repo via `--repo-root` ([#1450](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1450), [#1467](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1467)).
- Implementer, investigator and planner agents declare their effort ([#1484](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1484)).

### Upgrade

The plugin cache is version-keyed. Run `/plugin marketplace update blackhole-marketplace`, then reinstall the plugin, and restart Claude Code. A running session keeps its installed version until it restarts.
